name: Huh Cat
blurb: A chubby, wide-eyed cat paired with a confused "huh?" sound, a reaction meme since 2022
title: Huh Cat Meme: Meaning, Origin & the "Huh?" Sound
description: Huh Cat is a reaction meme of a chubby, shocked cat with a "huh?" sound; the clip spread on TikTok from 2021 and the "huh?" edit took off in 2023.
h1: What is the Huh Cat meme?
answer: Huh Cat is a short video of a chubby cat, known online as Ben, looking up with a confused, shocked face, paired with a "huh?" sound. The original clip of the cat meowing for food was posted on TikTok in September 2021 and used in memes on Russian-language TikTok. The "huh?" version first appeared in December 2022 and went viral in 2023, making it a go-to reaction for anything confusing.

body: A chubby cat stares at the camera looking shocked and confused, as if it cannot believe what it just heard. In the meme a quick "huh?" sound is placed over that moment, so the cat seems to be reacting to whatever came before in the video.

body.note: In the original clip the cat was simply meowing for food. The "huh?" sound was added later by meme makers.

head: Date
Event
rows: The cat's owner posts the original clip on TikTok; on 24 September another account starts using it in captioned memes.
The earliest known version with the "huh?" sound is posted on TikTok.
The original video, deleted earlier, is reposted by the owner.
A widely shared "huh?" repost goes viral, and the cat becomes a standard reaction clip.
A spin-off pairing it with a rambling goat starts the "Rambling Goat and Huh? Cat" format.

ul: Cutting to Huh Cat after someone says something confusing: "Teacher: the test is tomorrow. Me:" [huh?]
Replying with the clip in group chats instead of typing "what?"
Cat-meme story videos that stitch famous cat clips together, with Huh Cat as the confused one.
The goat spin-off, where a goat yells nonsense and the cat answers "huh?"

body: Huh Cat is a lasting reaction meme rather than a short trend. It is one of the regular cast of cat-meme clips used in TikTok storytelling videos and still appears whenever someone wants to act baffled.

faq.a: Online it is known as Ben, a chubby pet cat whose owner posted the original clip on TikTok.
